name: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek
source: Maria Gwozdek has not had it easy over the past few months. She lost her job, the landlord wants her out of the apartment by the end of the week, and her mother is seriously ill. At this juncture in life, Maria meets a stranger who offers her an unusual deal. The stranger will fulfill any of Maria's wishes. But in return for each wish, Maria will give them one of her organs.
translation: 过去几个月，玛丽亚·格沃兹德克过得并不轻松。她失去了工作，房东希望她在本周末之前搬出公寓，而她的母亲病得很重。在人生的这个关头，玛丽亚遇到了一位陌生人，他向她提供了一项不寻常的交易。陌生人会满足玛丽亚的任何愿望。但作为对每个愿望的回报，玛丽亚会给他们一个器官。
